_comment: TERMINAL RAIL (Terminal step 2, Sep 11 2026). Source of truth for the left rail on / — sections, order, labels. Guides groups are pulled from data/nav.json categories by label (guideCategories). Rendered by tools/build-rail.mjs into <!-- RAIL:START --> … <!-- RAIL:END -->. Every href must be a site path that exists in nav.json (or / /watchlist /indices /auctions); hash fragments allowed. Portfolios rows render client-side from the Vault mirror (read-only); screens switch the Screens panel via /#screen=<id>.
